text.p: Micron Electronics Inc. will integrate 3Com Corp.'s computer networking technologies into the manufacturer's electronic products and services under a strategic alliance, the companies said Wednesday.
The deal will allow Micron, based in Nampa, Idaho, to deliver complete solutions to customers by making their systems compatible with 3Com networking technologies, they said.
The companies said they would work closely to develop network-ready products and technologies.

Micron will also participate in Santa Clara, Calif.-based 3Com's branding, and ship its ClientPro product line and selected Millennia computer products certified as 3Com network-ready systems at no additional charge, it said.
Micron's stock rose 50 cents to $20.50, while 3Com rose $1.3125 to $35.125 on Nasdaq in late morning trading.
